_readme: S750, the cheap piles (2026-11-28). Plan s750a files the reading state_course_not_on_page (kb/_program_named_gaps.py, S748) where the committed capture finds a state-listed course on no line of the program's own page. The reading's fires are wrong about 4 times in 100, so each row is checked against a free read of its own page before it is planned: this read prints the page so a session and the plan's second reader can see whether any line prints the course. No model call, nothing written. College of Marin Studio Arts A.A.-T 46242: ART 135.

questions.art_135: Whether the Studio Arts A.A.-T page prints ART 135 (the page writes codes with no space, ART135) on any line, and each ART row it prints.
